## Install

**Windows 10 or 11:** download `Flick-windows-x64.exe`, put it in a folder where it can stay (for example `C:\Tools\Flick`) and double-click it. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Press **Alt+Space**.

**macOS 11 or newer** (preview, not yet tested by hand): download `Flick-macos.dmg`, open it and drag **Flick** to **Applications**. The first time you open it, macOS blocks it because it isn't notarized: open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Flick lives in the menu bar. Press **Option+Space**.

**Ubuntu 22.04 or newer** (preview, not yet tested by hand): download `flick_*_amd64.deb` and double-click it to install, or run `sudo apt install ./flick_*_amd64.deb`. Start **Flick** from the app list. Press **Ctrl+Alt+Space** (on Ubuntu's normal Wayland session Flick adds this shortcut to GNOME's keyboard settings itself).

**Other Linux** (preview): download `Flick-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, make it runnable (`chmod +x Flick-linux-x86_64.AppImage`) and run it.

Anyone can change the hotkey with **Change hotkey...** in the gear or tray menu. See the [README](https://github.com/Smartulf123/flick-launcher#readme) for settings.
